description: Explicit ICD-9/10 sepsis / severe sepsis / septic shock codes for a secondary fairness scorecard. Discharge diagnoses are never used as features or as primary PE-1 onset.
sources: ICD-10-CM: A40–A41 (sepsis), R65.20/R65.21 (severe sepsis ± septic shock), O85 (puerperal sepsis)
notes: Codes are normalized by stripping dots and uppercasing before match.
This set is intentionally narrower than infection+organ-failure composite criteria (e.g. Angus).
Do not replace sepsis3_onset primary labels with these codes.
